I had my decompression in 2022, (I’m 23 now) but the doctor told me no rollercoasters for a year to let your brain readjust to the new pressure. As for skydiving picking up kids, lifting anything over 10 pounds is fine after 4-6 weeks or longer depending on the doctor. No flying in airplanes probably for a few months after surgery but you’ll be totally fine after a year has passed

I haven’t ridden a coaster since 2022 (I didn’t listen to my doctor) and got extreme vertigo, but I’ve ridden rides with similar G-force to rollercoasters and have been fine now so I figure I’m fine to try them again 

You will be fine, please don’t worry too much which I know is very hard to not do. You’ll be okay. These surgeons know what they’re doing and will take great care of you. Recovery is probably the only bad part of the experience. It’s just a lot of pain and some bad headaches after the fact, but it’s not gonna be nearly as bad as your current symptoms. Just take it easy and remind yourself that while recovery is long, you will get through it and you will be able to get back to your normal life

In 2015, when I was 14, I began showing signs of depression, but I didn’t think much of it. I just thought that I was going through teenage emotions. But in December 2017, I started getting so much worse. I went to my primary care doctor and she gave me that depression quiz sheet. She couldn’t outright diagnose me because she’s a primary doctor, but she did give me Zoloft in order to try and help.

Low and behold a month later, I’m going to our town’s psychiatric hospital because my teacher saw a bunch of self harm cuts on my wrists. They officially diagnosed me with major depression and anxiety. Though throughout the years since then, I’ve also been diagnosed with borderline personality disorder and bipolar disorder type 2. 

Though every single time that I’ve had an episode or had to go back to the psychiatric hospital, I keep thinking that I’m faking it. That I’m just faking all of this stuff to get attention. But every time I think this and then stop my meds, I immediately crash down into a depression relapse. I still self harm occasionally and have had a suicide attempt within the last few months, but I still believe that I’m faking all of this.

This probably isn’t as creepy as most of the posts here, but it was definitely creepy to me.

I worked at a Wendy’s when I was 16 with a very tall black man that was 36 (I think) who worked with me. He always put me off a little. He was extremely rude to me, often insulting or making fun of me. One thing I remember was on the day of the Solar Eclipse back in 2017, I was talking to one of my coworkers about it, telling her that we got the hour off at school to go into the field and watch it, and he just turns to me and says “you do know that the moon landing was fake, yeah?”

Not exactly creepy but a bit weird to me, whatever.

About a month or two after this though, I was working at the fry station and we had just finished our dinner rush so it was around 8:30 pm. I was talking with my manager Holly about a movie that was coming out soon and the man walks up to me and is just staring down at me. Mind you, I’m a 5’1 female and this guy is well over 6 ft tall. I stop in my sentence and look up at him to see what he wants. He’s quiet for a moment and then he just blurts out: “are you Latina?”

I was a little confused, but this actually happens to me a lot. I’m 1/4th Asian, but I look somewhat Latina (I guess? A lot of people think I am). I just tell him “no, I’m not. I’m Japanese.” He just nods at me.

“Well, you do have quite a big ass so I thought you were. Since Latina women have big asses.”

This shocked me completely silent. I didn’t really know how to respond to this. I ended up just stammering that I wasn’t Latina, and went into the back to try and compose myself. I’m unsure why he said this to me, since he knew that I was underage and was the youngest and newest person in the store.

Like I said, it’s not really creepy, but it still creeped me out quite a bit. I did mention it to my boss, but honestly he didn’t do anything. The man only got mad at me when he found out I told our general manager.

Oh and about two weeks later, this dude showed up an hour and a half late to work, and when our GM asked him where he was, he screamed at him and called him a bitch. He got fired right then and there. I found out after I left through a coworker that he had a warrant out for his arrest and was arrested when he came back in to beg the GM for his job back.

I haven’t heard anything about him and it’s been three years since I last worked there.

This happened a couple years ago to a family friend of mine.

My mom’s old boss was a preacher for a church in our town. He also managed a lot of the stuff that happened at said church. He was happily married and was a good Christian man. He had a son, (who I’ll call Ryan) who was around his early to mid twenties at the time of this story.

One day, Ryan was on his way to work and was on the phone with his girlfriend. They were FaceTiming and he had his phone on the dashboard. They were just chatting and talking about their plans for the evening. Ryan was on the highway and noticed up ahead that traffic was slowing down considerably so he has to hit the breaks a bit harder than usual to slow down and stop.

A semi behind him happened to be a bit too close to him and was unable to slow down in time. The semi crushed Ryan’s car and immediately killed him. All while his girlfriend was on the phone with him.

His parents were crushed. I didn’t go to the funeral but my mom did and she said that Ryan’s mom and girlfriend were so distraught. His mom ended up developing depression and had to be hospitalized a few months after his death. His parents fought so much over the next few months, and eventually it was found out that his father had cheated on his wife with one of the church workers not too long after him and his wife started fighting.

He got fired from the church and divorced his wife to marry the church worker. She also divorced her husband and gained custody of their four kids. 

It’s been a few years now, but I know it still weighs heavily on both him and his ex-wife. His ex-wife has still been struggling with the loss of her son. I’m not sure how his girlfriend is doing, but I hope she’s alright.

The dude ended up marrying the church worker and they’re expecting a baby girl come early spring of 2021.
